brief.description: A compact steel bearing-and-shaft assembly with a functional copper-colored bushing
brief.purpose: Recognizable common assembly intermediate for advanced machines.
brief.silhouette: Squat steel bearing housing, short projecting shaft and visible copper-colored bearing collar; no pile of tiny objects.
brief.bounds: 32x32 native generated item, 28px extent and transparent padding.
brief.materials: Blue-gray steel, dark cast housing, warm copper bushing; sparse machined edge highlights and wear.
brief.interfaces: Existing machine_parts item, unchanged recipe and stack limits.
brief.construction: High-resolution master to shared alpha-safe item export and native item/generated model.
brief.invariants: Preserve two steel plus two copper recipe; no new gear or alloy ingredients.
brief.technological_stage: Town metalworking, practical late nineteenth-century machine assembly.
brief.material_behavior: Broad cool steel planes, narrow machined edges, restrained wear; copper only at functional bearing surface.
brief.signature_feature: Short steel shaft visibly seated in a warm copper collar on a dark steel housing.
brief.neighboring_assets: Steel ingot, Coal, sulfur and Cloth; Oil Engine material family.
fidelity_targets: Separate cool housing and warm functional collar
Sparse metal variation, no decorative gears

references.role: Material reference: cast iron/steel colors and restrained functional warm metal; do not copy machine layout.
Project sprite style: purposeful coarse shapes and subordinate surface marks, not mineral material or silhouette.

generations.prompt: Create one Minecraft inventory item representing MACHINE PARTS: a compact late-nineteenth-century steel bearing assembly, one squat blue-gray steel pillow-block housing with two short mounting feet, a clearly visible warm COPPER bearing collar, and one short solid steel shaft seated through its center, projecting toward the lower right. Three-quarter view, the shaft and circular collar opening legible. This is a functional component for an industrial workshop, no decorative gears, no clocks, no wires, no cog pile. Reference 1 is MATERIAL ONLY: cool cast iron and steel with small warm functional fittings. Reference 2 is PIXEL-ART STYLE ONLY: broad connected clusters and readable material variation, not sulfur colors or crystal shapes. High-resolution master composed for a tiny inventory icon. Strong compact silhouette, three major readable forms: housing, copper collar, shaft. Dark housing still readable, medium steel-blue planes and light machined edges. Restrained broad scuff marks across steel surfaces, approximately 1–3 final-pixel clusters; quieter than structural boundaries. Copper used only in collar, no gold trim. Simple two or three tones per material, about sixteen deliberate colors, crisp stepped edges, upper-left lighting. No gradients, microscopic machining, fine noise, bolts too small to read, lettering, glow, floor, cast shadow or border. Centered isolated object on true transparent background with generous margin.
